featureReviews.notes: Surface detail holds under all three lights (renders/surface-pass/lighting-checks.jpg): long grain on the boards, legs and log breaks the grazing highlight instead of a plastic sheen, the blade's lower roughness gives a soft brushed sheen and its streaks are calmer, the cut face keeps its rings. The reference paints the grain bolder and the blade's rim brighter; ours stays subtler, which suits the prop's ~100 px in-game size.
Brushed sheen visible in the grazing close-up; the bright rim of the reference is not modelled (no bevel on the extruded disc).
Plank seams, chamfers and grain read; under-top members fall into shadow.
Log streaks run along its length; pale ringed cut face toward the viewer.

summary: Surface pass: calmer brushing and a lower-roughness sheen on the blade, grain on boards, legs and log, rings on the cut face; materials stay distinct under the gate, reference-matched and grazing lights. Tier-1 IoU 0.887, aspect 0.012, scale 0.012, colour max dE 16.2; orbit gates pass.
